# OSINT Collection Framework

- Purpose: bounded, review-gated collection-plan validation for non-personal public metadata.
- Maturity: scaffolded plan validator; no network or collection client.
- Start: README.md
- Contract: docs/COLLECTION-CONTRACT.md
- Privacy/lawfulness: docs/PRIVACY-AND-LAWFULNESS.md
- Integration gates: docs/INTEGRATION-GATES.md
- Schema: schemas/collection-request.schema.json
- Validator: osint_collection/planner.py
- Tests: tests/
- Dependencies: osint-source-registry, identity-trust, policy-engine, audit-provenance, emergency-control, compliance-governance, secure-supply-chain (declared only).
- License: scoped mixed-license policy in LICENSE.md; file-level provenance and redistribution review remains required.
